prompts.fresh: Create ONE spacious animation reference atlas, eight SMALL full-body portraits of the SAME adult lavender mermaid moon goddess from image1, with soft fine fantasy painting style from image2. Wide 2:1 transparent canvas. Arrange EIGHT miniatures in a rigid FOUR-column TWO-row grid, like eight separate stickers with LARGE INVISIBLE GUTTERS. Each portrait is only 65% of its cell width and height, with at least 15% blank alpha space at every cell edge. Do not fill the cells: deliberately make each complete character SMALL with lots of empty transparent breathing room. All eight have exactly the SAME face HEIGHT, head scale, eye scale, chest HEIGHT, waist HEIGHT, crown-top y and pelvis y. Anatomical proportions are identical adult proportions from image1. No bobbing, no breathing, no resizing. Include whole figure and all hair/tail. Eight gradually changing orientations in exact reading order: 0 full profile looking RIGHT; 1 looking RIGHT but beginning to turn toward viewer; 2 right three-quarter; 3 almost front with nose angled slightly right; 4 almost front with nose angled slightly LEFT; 5 left three-quarter; 6 nearly left profile; 7 full LEFT profile. Thus top row looks right, bottom row looks LEFT. Same gold crescent moon crown and pearl ornaments, lavender silver flowing long hair, violet eyes open, elegant calm face, white-lavender fitted bodice, iridescent lilac mermaid tail, translucent flowing veil and tail fins, relaxed hands near waist. Hair and fins lag smoothly behind the yaw motion, no changes of outfit. Fine polished luminous illustration, no thick cartoon outlines, no extra characters. Keep natural original opacity, no fading. Remove background COMPLETELY: real alpha transparency, NO backdrop/checkerboard/grid/letters/labels/sparkle clouds/floating flecks between characters. It is essential that the center horizontal gutter and all three vertical gutters are wide and completely empty transparent. Each figure must fit entirely in its own cell, never overlap. Do not reproduce the framing of the reference; use it only for character identity.
prompts.cleanup: Clean production sprite atlas EDIT. Preserve these eight Lunea mermaid poses and character identity. OUTPUT exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, transparent RGBA. CRITICAL remove ALL stray white, blue, magenta pixels, haze, dithering, glitter, and disconnected specks outside the solid character silhouettes. Absolutely empty transparent gutters. Each entire pose must sit within the central 75 percent of its square cell, leaving 12.5 percent completely blank margin on ALL FOUR sides. Same head size, chest size, waist level and head height across all eight poses. No per-pose enlargement, no opacity fade. Eight small isolated complete mermaids with generous spacing, row-major right profile through front to left profile. Fully opaque character interiors, only antialiased outlines. No text, no frame lines. Make silhouettes clean enough for a real game.
